def _check_recent_visual_review(project: str, hours: int = 2) -> bool:
    """Check if a visual review was performed within the last *hours*."""
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    from pathlib import Path
    try:
        from core import paths as _paths
        review_file = _paths.project_dir(project) / "_last_visual_review.json"
        if not review_file.exists():
            return False
        data = json.loads(review_file.read_text())
        ts = datetime.fromisoformat(data["timestamp"])
        if ts.tzinfo is None:
            ts = ts.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        return (datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc) - ts).total_seconds() < hours * 3600
    except Exception:
        return False
